matching_policy.unmatched_message: No mobile health design threat scenario matched.

scenarios.name: Verified Mobile Link Routing
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the implementation verify mobile links and authorize every routed clinical object?
risk_identification: Missing domain association allows link hijacking by another application.
Route parameters may cause unauthorized direct object access.
security_control_requirements: Verify iOS and Android domain-association files during release testing.
Use a route allowlist and reject unknown parameters.
Perform server-side object authorization after link routing.
verification_points: Domain-association files are part of release acceptance tests.
The router has explicit route and parameter allowlists.
Every clinical object is authorized by the backend.

scenarios.name: Protected Offline Mobile Storage
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the mobile storage design protect cached clinical data throughout its lifecycle?
risk_identification: Plaintext or backup-eligible mobile storage may disclose clinical records.
Key material not bound to the device may be extracted with copied data.
security_control_requirements: Wrap database keys with Android Keystore or iOS Keychain protection.
Exclude clinical data from operating-system and cloud backups.
Test secure purge and screenshot protection on supported devices.
verification_points: The data model identifies encrypted and non-persistent fields.
Backup exclusion is set for every clinical cache file.
Logout acceptance tests verify secure purge.

scenarios.name: Platform Biometric Enforcement
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the application enforce strong platform biometrics and safe fallback behavior?
risk_identification: Weak fallback settings can reduce biometric authentication to a low-assurance device credential.
Failure to invalidate keys after biometric enrollment changes may retain stale access.
security_control_requirements: Require BIOMETRIC_STRONG or the equivalent iOS owner-authentication policy.
Invalidate protected keys when biometric enrollment changes.
Use a short-lived server step-up token for high-risk actions.
verification_points: Supported platform policies are documented by operating-system version.
High-risk APIs require a valid server step-up token.
